title: Continuity-of-government succession: Harrington was number 16

plain: John Harrington served as US Secretary of Energy in the 1980s. He tells podcast host Jesse Michels that he was part of the continuity-of-government plan, the secret arrangement to keep the government running after a catastrophe, and that he was number 16 in the line of succession. He says he remembers it because his daughter sewed a big 16 on the back of his swimsuit, a detail he gives to show how close he was to the inner workings of power.
